name: Pushary
description: Ask the user a question on their phone, wait for the answer, and send a push when a long task finishes.
notes: Uses Pushary's hosted MCP server. The key is a Pushary API key (pk_...), scoped to one Pushary workspace: questions and pushes go to the phones and Mac apps signed in to that workspace. Its tools include ask_user, wait_for_answer, cancel_question, send_notification, schedule_reminder and propose_scope. Approving each terminal command or file edit before it runs is a separate part of Pushary that uses OpenHands hooks, not this MCP server; the docs page covers both. Needs a paid Pushary plan.
installHint: Create a Pushary API key, or run `npx -y pushary@latest setup --agents none` to sign in and save one to ~/.pushary/config.json, then paste the pk_... key. If Decision cards are on and Pushary is your only MCP server, OpenHands sees two ask_user tools; add a second MCP server or turn Decision cards off.

auth.credentialHelp: Create a key in the Pushary dashboard under Settings, API keys, or see [Pushary API keys](https://pushary.com/docs/agents/api-key). Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>. The key reaches one Pushary workspace.
